Looking at the grid, I can assign coordinates to the vertices of the shaded quadrilateral: (0,0), (2,3), (5,4), and (3,1).

**Shoelace formula:**
Area = ½|x₁(y₂−y₄) + x₂(y₃−y₁) + x₃(y₄−y₂) + x₄(y₁−y₃)|
= ½|0(3−1) + 2(4−0) + 5(1−3) + 3(0−4)|
= ½|0 + 8 − 10 − 12| = ½(14) = 7

**Check:** The side from (0,0) to (2,3) is the vector (2,3), and the side from (3,1) to (5,4) is also (2,3), so the shape is a parallelogram. The cross product of (2,3) and (3,1) is 2·1 − 3·3 = −7, giving area 7. ✓

\boxed{7}
